# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-28 from the 2026-11-28 Hub dump.

- 3,273,553 models tracked, 949,917 declare a base model, 982,986 parent links, 94,649 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
